title: A forked Codex thread samples its account generation before its launch admission, so a concurrent account action can stamp it with the older generation
outcome: A fork made under the current Codex account records that account's generation even when an account action completes around the fork.
acceptance: fork_codex_thread reads the account generation while holding the Codex launch admission through the thread/fork request, so no account action can advance it in between, shown by a behaviour test.
A fork made before an account action still counts as older than that action.
